description: Deliberately unreachable: one billion frames cannot complete inside any laboratory timeout. Proves that `replay run`/`replay compare` under --timeout report `timeout` and exit 4.
tested_behavior: Laboratory only: bounded execution of the comparator.

inputs.injection_point: Buttons are presented on the libretro input callback before retro_run of the frame numbered `from`..`to` (0-based frames after power-on) and withdrawn before the following frame; the core polls the controllers once per frame (R-0002 finding 6). Sub-frame timing is not available.

fields.name: wram_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the 131072-byte work RAM ($7E0000-$7FFFFF) at the end of the frame

fields.name: registers
fields.description: CPU register block at the end of the frame: pc, a, x, y, s, d, b, p, e, mdr, vcounter, hcounter, field, wai, stp
